_authority: Owner-edited only. ap3/dispatch.sh reads this file and never writes it. A class is dispatchable only while status == enabled and not paused in ap3/state/trust.json. allowed_scope is the ceiling a queued task's scope must fit inside; widen it only from evidence rows, never to make one task fit.

bugfix-small.description: Small, behaviour-preserving fixes with a test that pins the acceptance criterion. No schema/migration, no auth/permission/money logic.
